name: train-and-dare
description: Train&Dare – Frontend, Backend (data = JSON files, pas de DB externe)

scripts.check: npm run check --prefix train-dare-backend && npm run check --prefix train-dare-frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix train-dare-backend && npm run build --prefix train-dare-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix train-dare-backend" "npm run dev --prefix train-dare-frontend"
